dev.title: Gifteez needs a Firebase config before it can sign in.
dev.body: Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the Firebase values, then rebuild the native app. Restarting Metro is not enough, because the env file is read at build time.
dev.safe: The app is running. Nothing was sent to a server.

startup.title: Gifteez could not start
startup.config: Firebase is not configured on this phone. Fill in .env and rebuild the native app.
startup.network: The phone could not reach Firebase. Check the connection and try again.
startup.auth: Anonymous sign-in is turned off. In the Firebase console, open Authentication and enable Anonymous, then try again.

firstOpen.title: Who are you shopping for?
firstOpen.lead: Type their name. Gift ideas are on the next screen.
firstOpen.sentence: Gifteez helps you remember gifts for the people you love, and keep the spending fair.
firstOpen.pasteHint: If you copied an invite before installing, paste it here. Gifteez does not read the clipboard on its own.

groupCreate.title: Name yourself
groupCreate.body: This name is how your group sees you. Pick it carefully. It stays once the list is saved.
groupCreate.name: Your name
groupCreate.listNameHint: Leave this blank and the list is named from the people in it, like Mike, Sam & Jo.
groupCreate.secureTitle: Save this list to your email
groupCreate.secureBody: Optional. You can skip this and add an email later from Settings.
groupCreate.emailWhy: There is no password. Gifteez emails you a link, and opening that link on this phone signs you in. That is how the same list follows you to a new phone.
groupCreate.recoveryWhy: Next, Gifteez shows a recovery code. Write it down. It unlocks the list on a new phone after you sign in, and Gifteez cannot read it or reset it.
groupCreate.secondDevice: I already use Gifteez on another phone
groupCreate.linkSent: Check your email and open the link on this phone, or paste it below.
groupCreate.smsRegion: Text messages are limited to US numbers at launch.
groupCreate.recoveryBody: These words unlock your list on a new phone after you sign in with your email link. Gifteez cannot read them, and they cannot be reset. You can also open this code later from the group screen on this phone.
groupCreate.later: I'll open it later on this phone
groupCreate.showLater: You can view this code again on this phone from the group screen.
groupCreate.savedAccount: You're signed in. If you switch phones, the recovery code under Group unlocks this list. Gifteez can't see it.

people.title: People
people.empty: Add someone you shop for. Ideas show up on the next screen.
people.remindersOn: Reminders are on for this phone.
people.banner: You have used Gifteez for a while. Saving an email keeps your list if this phone is replaced.
people.cap: The free list holds {count} people. A one-time unlock removes the cap.

person.name: Name
person.tagsHint: Tap a few interests. The ideas above will shift.
person.occasionsEmpty: No occasions yet. Add a birthday or any date.
person.noOccasionMatch: No occasion by that name. Add your own below.
person.dateEstimated: This year's date isn't published yet, so the saved day is a stand-in.
person.ideasHint: A few ideas to start. Tap an interest and they get closer.
person.ideasEmpty: No ideas yet. Add a date and a few interests.
person.saveIdeaNeedsDate: Add a date below and this idea can stay with it.
person.remindBody: Gifteez can remind you a week before, and on the day. Your phone will ask once.
person.cloudHint: This is the only button that calls the cloud. Fresh answers count toward the cap.
person.historyMineEmpty: You have not logged a purchase for this person.
person.samePersonLabel: Mark this person as the same as someone on another list
person.deleteConfirmBody: They leave this list. You can undo it for a few seconds.
person.deleteGiftBody: You can undo it for a few seconds.
person.readOnly: This person is read-only until the list is unlocked or someone is removed. Nothing was deleted.
person.hiddenRecipient: You are this person on the list, so gifts, claims, and ideas stay hidden.
person.linkHint: The member you pick can still see the name and the date. They cannot read gifts, claims, or ideas.
person.openedImported: Opening this person turns ideas on. Imported people stay quiet until then.

purchase.title: Log a purchase
purchase.claimedWarning: {name} already said they would get this. You can still log a purchase.

merge.title: Same person
merge.pick: Pick the person on another list.
merge.empty: You don't have this person on another list.
merge.gifts: Gifts to share with the group
merge.giftHint: Uncheck a gift to keep it private. Only you will see it on this person.
merge.privateNote: Unchecked gifts stay on a private record only you can read.
merge.done: Merged. The other copy was removed.
merge.confirmBody: This copies the checked gifts onto this person and removes the other copy after it saves. You can undo it from the person.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.intro: This year, side by side. Lower spend is listed first.

groupScreen.title: Group
groupScreen.inviteHint: Only share this with people you shop with. Anyone who opens it can read the list. A list holds up to {count} people.
groupScreen.leaveBody: You can undo it for a few seconds.
groupScreen.removeBody: You can undo it for a few seconds.
groupScreen.recoveryWhy: These words unlock this list on a new phone. Gifteez can't read them. You only need them if you switch phones.
groupScreen.nameHint: Blank uses the members' names. Showing as {name}.
groupScreen.oneList: A free account can start one list. Unlock to start another. You can still join lists other people start.
groupScreen.shareText: Join my Gifteez list "{name}" so we don't double-gift. {link}
groupScreen.full: This list already has {count} members, the most a list can have.
groupScreen.ownerStays: Hand the list to someone else before you leave. You started it.
groupScreen.emptyCode: There is no recovery code on this phone.
groupScreen.notCurrent: Not up to date on this phone

join.title: Join a list
join.body: Paste the invite link from the person who started the list.
join.invalid: That link is missing the list, the invite, or the key.
join.failedInvalid: That invite is invalid or has expired.
join.failedOffline: You are offline, so the list was not joined. Try again when you are connected.
join.failedUnknown: The list could not be joined. Try again.
join.recovery: Recovery code from your other phone
join.needAccount: Sign in with the email you saved, then enter the recovery code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.anonymous: This phone is signed in quietly. Saving an email or a US mobile number keeps the same list.
settings.exportHint: Sharing the list asks you to save your account first.
settings.unlocked: More lists and unlimited people are on.
settings.storeMissing: The store has no product for this build yet. The rest of the app still works.
settings.pasteHint: CSV or JSON from Santa's Bag, Christmas Gift List Tracker, or a spreadsheet with a name column.
settings.optional: These are optional. Gifteez never imports anyone on its own.
settings.remindersHint: Turning reminders on asks your phone for notification permission, so a date can nudge you.
settings.calendarHint: This asks to read birthdays from your calendar. Nothing is added until you pick people.
settings.contactsHint: This asks to read contacts so you can pick people. Nothing is added until you choose.
settings.remindersLabel: Turn occasion reminders on or off
settings.deleteAccountBody: This releases lists you own and removes you from lists you joined. It cannot be undone.

importFlow.none: Nothing to add from that source.
importFlow.added: Added {count}. They stay quiet until you open them.
importFlow.added_one: Added {count} person. They stay quiet until you open them.
importFlow.added_other: Added {count} people. They stay quiet until you open them.

sync.offline: Saved on this phone. It will sync when the connection is back.
sync.permission: Gifteez could not prove this install to the server. Your changes are still on this phone. In development, register the App Check debug token from the device log.
sync.failed: Gifteez could not sync just now. Your changes are still on this phone.
sync.offlineBanner: Offline. Changes stay on this phone until the connection is back.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your latest change is still on this phone.
errors.oneList: A free account can start one list. Unlock to start another.
errors.auth: Sign-in did not finish. You can keep going and try again later.
errors.functions: Cloud ideas are unavailable right now.
errors.capReached: The cloud idea cap for this person is used up.
errors.notConfigured: The server is not set up to confirm purchases yet.
errors.full: This list already has {count} members, the most a list can have.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.claimed: Someone else already said they would get this.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who claimed this, or the list owner, can unclaim it.
errors.price: Enter a price of zero or more.
errors.sourceKey: That list's key is not on this phone, so the merge was not started.
errors.mergePush: The merge did not finish saving, so it was undone.

occasionNotes.moon: The published date can shift a day where you live.
occasionNotes.teacher: Tuesday of the first full week of May.
